blocks.text: Pageantry is still a booming industry in Southeast Asia, but the region will have fewer representation in the upcoming 75th Miss Universe pageant in Puerto Rico next month. Over the weekend, the pageant opened its online fan voting on the official Miss Universe mobile app, with slots for several countries’ representatives missing. These were the same ones mentioned by a pageant official in an earlier interview that would not be participating this year.
